page: Microsoft Azure D48plds_v5 is an ARM64 virtual machine belonging to the DPLDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores powered by an Ampere Altra ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. The system is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It includes 1843 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage, but does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance scoring 85051.53, placing it in the top 25%. Geekbench software compilation with Clang also demonstrates strong performance at 39975.0. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 1117.0. Memory bandwidth is moderate, reaching 176.14 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations. Database operations are highly efficient, highlighted by Redis SET operations achieving 62.24 million operations per second.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The inclusion of 1843 GB of local storage makes it highly suitable for applications requiring fast local scratch space. Recommended workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, web serving, database operations, and lightweight machine learning inference, whereas memory-intensive applications or heavy single-threaded tasks may experience performance bottlenecks.
